mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile_login_log ( profile_id, mobile_no, login_type, login_ip, login_lat, login_lng, module_status, last_request_id ) VALUES ( #{profileId}, #{mobileNo}, #{loginType}, #{loginIp}, #{loginLat}, #{loginLng}, #{moduleStatus}, #{lastRequestId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mobile_no = VALUES(mobile_no), login_type = VALUES(login_type), login_ip = VALUES(login_ip), login_lat = VALUES(login_lat), login_lng = VALUES(login_lng), module_status = VALUES(module_status), last_request_id = VALUES(last_request_id)
